freeOrZeroCostItems: Cognito Essentials under the 10000 MAU free tier
assumptions: The existing production network, security, compute, runtime, request-control and alert stacks are updated in place; no duplicate ALB or always-on ECS service is created.
Two 0.25-vCPU and 0.5-GiB Linux/x86 Fargate tasks run continuously; a rolling deployment can temporarily run four.
RDS PostgreSQL uses one db.t4g.medium Multi-AZ deployment and 100 GiB gp3, exactly matching the proposed CDK target.

The model includes two-AZ Secrets Manager and SNS interface endpoints, one ALB LCU, 20 GiB of metered logs, 20 GiB of backup storage beyond included RDS automated-backup storage, 10 GB of internet transfer, and low SES/SNS/SQS/Lambda traffic.
T4g unlimited CPU-credit overage, storage autoscaling above 100 GiB, unusually high WAF/log traffic, and taxes are outside the projection and are protected by budget/anomaly alarms.
Current production source scale is far below the storage and identity allowances; source counts are read-only evidence, not a growth guarantee.
